title: Job
description: One generation, as it stands right now. Returned when the job is accepted and returned again by every poll, so a caller reads one shape from submission to outcome.

job_id.description: The job, for polling. Issued by the core and opaque to the caller.

submitted_at.description: When the core accepted the request.

started_at.description: When work began, or null while the job is still queued.

finished_at.description: When the job reached an outcome, or null while it has not.

result.description: The generation trace, present exactly when the job succeeded and null otherwise.

error.description: Why the job failed, present exactly when it did and null otherwise.

JobStatus.description: Where the job is. `queued` and `running` are the states a caller polls through; `succeeded` and `failed` are terminal and a caller stops.
